name: Phoenix VIII
description:
Phoenix VIII is a beachfront condo property located in the heart of Orange Beach, offering direct access to the sugar-white sand and sweeping Gulf views. Each luxury condo faces the water, with expansive Gulf-front balconies and floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the Gulf of Mexico and nearby Perdido Pass.
